title: AWS Engineer
company: Daily Tour and Travel Pvt. Ltd
description:
Experience: 3\+ Years

Employment Type: Full\-Time

We are looking for a hands\-on AWS DevOps \& Infrastructure Security Engineer with strong experience in managing, deploying, securing, and troubleshooting AWS production infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

\- Manage and secure AWS infrastructure and production environments.

\- Work extensively with EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, Route 53, CloudWatch, EBS, Lambda, Load Balancer, CloudFront, Security Groups, NACLs, Lightsail, etc.

\- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, Self\-Hosted Runners, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar tools.

\- Manage application deployments, releases, rollbacks, and production environments.

\- Build, manage, and troubleshoot Docker containers and images.

\- Manage and harden Linux servers, including users, permissions, services, processes, logs, performance, and system security.

\- Implement AWS, infrastructure, and application security, including IAM, least privilege, VPC security, firewall rules, SSL/TLS, encryption, secrets, Security Groups, NACLs, and server/application hardening.

\- Handle DNS, Nginx/Apache, Load Balancers, ports, firewalls, SSH, TCP/IP, routing, subnets, NAT, and network troubleshooting.

\- Develop Bash/Shell or Python scripts for automation, deployment, monitoring, backup, and maintenance.

\- Manage backup, restore, disaster recovery, data/server/application/database migration.

\- Monitor infrastructure and applications and independently troubleshoot production, deployment, networking, server, and security issues.

\- Maintain Git, branching, repositories, access control, and deployment workflows.

\- Perform R\&D and root\-cause analysis and implement preventive solutions.

Mandatory Skills

\- AWS – Strong hands\-on experience

\- Linux – Strong administration \& troubleshooting

\- Docker – Mandatory

\- Networking – Strong knowledge

\- AWS / Infrastructure / Application Security – Strong knowledge

\- Git \& Version Control

\- CI/CD – GitLab preferred

\- Bash/Shell and/or Python scripting

\- Backup, Restore \& Migration

\- Production troubleshooting \& problem\-solving

Good to Have / Optional

Kubernetes/EKS, Helm, Terraform/Pulumi/CloudFormation, Ansible, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, IaC, GitOps, DevSecOps, security scanning, AWS cost optimization/autoscaling, Istio/Linkerd, and relevant certifications.

Note: Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, and other optional technologies are not mandatory. Strong practical experience in AWS \+ Linux \+ Docker \+ Networking \+ Security \+ CI/CD is the primary requirement.

We Are Looking For

\- 3\+ years of relevant DevOps/AWS/Cloud/Infrastructure experience.

\- Strong hands\-on approach rather than only theoretical knowledge.

\- Self\-learner with strong R\&D, analytical and problem\-solving skills.

\- Ability to independently handle critical production issues calmly.

\- Strong security mindset with the ability to secure applications, servers, networks, and AWS infrastructure.

\- Ability to take complete ownership from issue identification → troubleshooting → resolution → prevention.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: AWS Data Platform and Governance Engineer
description:
Help migrate enterprise data access and lakehouse tables to a governed AWS platform. This profile has two specialisms: access governance and lakehouse conversion. State your primary specialism; the assignment will match demonstrated depth.

**What you will deliver**

* Review catalogue, table and role inventories; identify readiness gaps, dependencies and migration risks with AWS consultants and customer engineers.
* For governance assignments, migrate BI and Athena access to project\-scoped roles; troubleshoot permissions, audit role activity and support onboarding and offboarding.
* For lakehouse assignments, assess Delta tables and implement repeatable Iceberg conversion, reconciliation, query validation and recovery procedures.
* Test row and column access in non\-production, including both allowed and denied cases; document implementation decisions and handover evidence.

**Essential experience**

* Hands\-on AWS Glue Data Catalog, Athena, S3 and IAM; strong SQL and practical Python automation; evidence of debugging a live data platform issue.
* Governance specialism: implemented fine\-grained access controls, preferably with Lake Formation; can trace authorisation and data access across services.
* Lakehouse specialism: hands\-on Spark, Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake migration or interoperability; can explain schema compatibility, parity tests and safe cutover.

**Useful additional experience:** CloudTrail analysis, infrastructure as code, cross\-team migrations and automated security tests. The exact enterprise governance implementation will be confirmed during discovery.

**Early delivery expectations**

A validated inventory, an agreed migration design and a representative change with reproducible data or access tests. Senior candidates should be able to own design trade\-offs and coordinate dependencies.

**What to include with your CV**

Describe one relevant migration or access\-control implementation, your personal contribution, its scale, a failure you diagnosed and the checks used to accept the outcome.

Include role code, current Indian city, exact earliest start date, interview availability and expected engagement terms. customer details are confidential.

Pay: Up to ₹3,400,000\.00 per year

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Notice Period

title: AI/ML Solution Engineer
description:
AI/ML Solution Engineer

**Location:** Gurgaon  
**Work Model:** Hybrid – 3 days from office  
**Shift:** Second Shift – 2:30 PM to 10:30 PM  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years Only

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced **AI/ML Solution Engineer** with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in **AI/ML, Generative AI, AWS, Python, LLMs, RAG, and AI agent\-based solutions**.

The ideal candidate should have strong practical experience in building and delivering AI/GenAI solutions, with a good understanding of **Machine Learning concepts, model evaluation, AI Evals, observability, and responsible AI**.

**Python is mandatory. Familiarity with Java is preferred.**

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, deploy, and maintain cloud\-native applications and services on AWS.
* Build and integrate Generative AI solutions using **Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, and Bedrock AgentCore**.
* Develop AI agents and multi\-agent workflows using **Bedrock Agents, AgentCore, AWS Strands SDK, LangChain, LangGraph**, or similar frameworks.
* Build AI\-powered applications using **LLMs, RAG architectures, and agent\-based solutions**.
* Develop scalable and resilient event\-driven solutions using **EventBridge, SQS, SNS, Lambda, and Step Functions**.
* Design and develop **REST APIs, microservices, and serverless applications** following AWS best practices.
* Implement data storage and retrieval solutions using **RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, and S3**.
* Partner with architects and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Contribute to system design, architecture reviews, and technical discussions.
* Troubleshoot production issues and optimize application performance, reliability, scalability, and cost.
* Develop infrastructure automation and CI/CD pipelines using Infrastructure as Code principles.
* Implement AI observability to monitor **model performance, prompt effectiveness, response quality, latency, usage patterns, and application health**.
* Develop and execute **AI Evaluation (AI Evals) frameworks** to assess:
* Model accuracy
* Relevance
* Groundedness
* Safety
* Response quality
* Overall GenAI/agent effectiveness
* Establish monitoring, logging, tracing, and evaluation mechanisms to identify **hallucinations, drift, performance issues, and reliability concerns**.
* Implement AI guardrails, content safety controls, auditability, and risk management processes.
* Follow enterprise AI governance, data privacy, security, compliance, and responsible AI practices.

Mandatory Skills

* **3–5 years of relevant experience in AI/ML / GenAI solution engineering**
* **Strong hands\-on Python development – Mandatory**
* Hands\-on experience delivering **AI/Generative AI solutions**
* Strong understanding of **Machine Learning concepts**
* Practical knowledge of **AI Model Evaluation / AI Evals – Mandatory**
* Experience with **LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, and AI agents**
* Hands\-on experience with **AWS AI/ML services**, preferably Bedrock and SageMaker
* Experience with **Bedrock AgentCore / AI agent frameworks**
* Knowledge of **LangChain, LangGraph, AWS Strands SDK**, or similar frameworks
* Understanding of cloud\-native architecture and distributed systems
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, and serverless architecture
* Understanding of event\-driven architecture
* Strong system design and problem\-solving skills

Preferred Skills

* Familiarity with **Java**
* AWS services such as Lambda, S3, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions, DynamoDB, RDS, and Aurora
* CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code
* AI observability and monitoring
* AI guardrails and responsible AI
* Experience with production\-grade GenAI applications
